website_summary.name: Women's Health Survey Portal
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and organized form interface for women to submit their health-related information, featuring a structured layout with distinct sections for various health details.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist design with a white background and uses "whitesmoke" as the default background color for its main container. It features a header with the title "Women's Health Survey" in bold text, followed by a brief instruction. Below the header, there is a form divided into several sections, each labeled clearly with fields such as Name, Age, Blood Type, Allergies, Current Medications, Medical Conditions, Lifestyle Factors, Family Medical History, Reproductive Health History, Pregnancy Complications, Sexual Health Concerns, Mental Health Status, Exercise Habits, Sleep Patterns, and Nutrition Habits. Each section includes appropriate input fields like text boxes, dropdown menus, and text areas. The form is styled with "dark cyan" accents for buttons and highlighted elements, providing a visually appealing contrast. The overall layout is responsive, adapting well to different screen sizes.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to fill out a comprehensive health survey form. It includes fields for personal information, medical history, lifestyle factors, reproductive health, mental health, exercise habits, sleep patterns, and nutrition. Users can select their blood type from a dropdown menu, enter text in various fields, and submit the form using a prominent "Submit" button. Upon submission, the system collects the entered data for further processing, including data management, permission management, data review, and reporting. The form also ensures proper validation of inputs before submission.
